provenance.notes: R0-LEG-002 captures executable artifacts and R0 scientific tasks freeze numeric tolerances.

oracles.claim: Publishing t_k does not advance continuous state.
expected_facts: Committed state is exactly unchanged by publish at each boundary.
Published truth reflects committed state at t_k and retains that sample until the next publish boundary.
oracles.tolerance_policy: exact publish state identity, sample time and event order; synthetic scalar values use absolute tolerance 1e-12

oracles.claim: The preserved fixed-step phase order is explicit and observable.
expected_facts: A due probe in each macro phase runs exactly once in environment, perturbation, input, process, output, interaction and evaluation order.
Scrambled cross-phase registration and priority values cannot change the macro phase sequence.
oracles.reference_kind: raw Legacy invocation trace plus independent scheduler trace
oracles.tolerance_policy: exact event identity, order, multiplicity, step and time

oracles.claim: Continuous candidates are computed before a synchronized commit.
expected_facts: Every continuous candidate completes before any commit for the step.
The distinguishing linear case ends at mass=8 and position=10; an early mass commit produces position=8.
oracles.tolerance_policy: exact event identity and candidate-before-commit partial order; synthetic scalar values use absolute tolerance 1e-12

oracles.claim: Shared RK candidate-state behavior is preserved by IntegrationScopePlan.
expected_facts: Mass and position members observe one joint candidate state at all four RK stages, yielding mass=8 and position=9 after dt=1.
The joint candidate commits once to all declared members; unregistered membership and duplicate scope ownership are rejected.
oracles.reference_kind: raw Legacy RK stage trace plus independent Decimal and C++17 joint-state references
oracles.tolerance_policy: exact stage/event/membership identity and order; synthetic scalar absolute tolerance 1e-12; YYZ trajectory tolerance remains pending R0-SCI-003

oracles.claim: Each recorded time identifies t_k and fields follow declared publish/update boundaries.
expected_facts: The three rows identify t0=0, t1=0.5 s and t2=1 s and contain the state published at each boundary.
Header-based semantic mapping accepts column permutation while rejecting missing, shifted, stale or duplicate required data.
oracles.reference_kind: raw Legacy CSV captures plus semantic field map and independent Decimal/C++17 references
oracles.tolerance_policy: exact semantic field identity and row order; Legacy seed time absolute tolerance 1e-12 and state absolute tolerance 1e-9; target YYZ field tolerances remain pending R0-SCI-003

oracles.claim: A stopping state is observed before the run reaches its terminal outcome.
expected_facts: The terminal observation contains the stopping state and precedes the final RunOutcome.

oracles.claim: Case materialization remains outside single-mission runtime semantics.
expected_facts: Each materialized case replays through the ordinary compile and run path with deterministic identity.
oracles.tolerance_policy: semantic input equality and deterministic case identity
